title: Garlic-Scallion Grilled Mussels
shortDescription: Live mussels are grilled until their shells open, then tossed with a separately prepared hot garlic-scallion sesame dressing.
culturalContext: Mussels appear in Korean soups, stews, and contemporary grilled preparations. This garlic-scallion grill draft is an adaptation requiring shellfish and cultural review.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
equipment: Outdoor grill or manufacturer-approved indoor electric grill

ingredients.preparation: required source tag or label retained

instructions.heading: Verify source and shells
instructions.action: Retain required tag or label, keep mussels cold, and discard cracked shells or open shells that do not close when tapped.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not cook dead, cracked, untagged, or temperature-abused mussels.

instructions.heading: Clean briefly
instructions.action: Scrub shells and remove loose beards immediately before cooking; do not soak in fresh water.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Shells are clean and mussels remain closed or responsive.
instructions.safetyNote: Sanitize the sink and brush after raw-shellfish contact.

instructions.heading: Cook dressing
instructions.action: Warm neutral oil in a small clean pan, cook garlic until fragrant, then add scallions, soy sauce, and sesame oil; keep separate.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Garlic is fragrant without browning deeply.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep this clean dressing free of raw-mussel liquid.

instructions.heading: Grill until open
instructions.action: Spread mussels on the hot grill tray, cover, and cook until shells open.
instructions.safetyNote: Discard every mussel that does not open; do not pry it open to eat.

instructions.heading: Dress with clean tools
instructions.action: Transfer only opened mussels to a clean bowl and toss with the hot dressing.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Opened mussels are glossy and steaming.
instructions.safetyNote: Use clean tongs and avoid hot shell edges and steam.

instructions.heading: Serve promptly
instructions.action: Move to a clean platter and serve immediately.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Only opened cooked mussels are served.
instructions.safetyNote: Refrigerate within 2 hours; discard table-exposed portions after unsafe holding.

grillSetup: Use an outdoor grill or approved indoor electric grill with a stable heat-safe tray over medium-high heat; keep raw and cooked shellfish tools separate.
targetInternalTemperature: Cook until shells open during cooking; discard every mussel that does not open.
foodSafetyNotes: Buy tagged or labeled live mussels and keep cold.
Discard cracked, dead, unresponsive, or non-opening mussels.
Never soak live mussels in fresh water.
Prevent raw-shellfish cross-contact and shell/steam injuries.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains shellfish, soy, wheat/gluten, and sesame; verify labels.

substitutions: Do not substitute frozen or pre-cooked mussels without a separate process.
ingredientSourcing: Buy live mussels from a reputable certified dealer and retain required source information.
makeAhead: Buy and cook live shellfish the same day when possible; prepare topping separately and refrigerate.
storage: Refrigerate cooked shellfish in a shallow covered container within 2 hours and use within 2 days pending qualified review.
reheating: Reheat only the needed portion until steaming; discard any shellfish held unsafely.
leftovers: Use only properly refrigerated leftovers within the approved window.
servingSuggestions: Serve hot with rice or noodles.

faq.question: Why discard closed mussels?
faq.answer: A shell that does not open during cooking must not be eaten.

faq.question: Can I soak mussels to clean them?
faq.answer: No. Scrub briefly under running water and keep them cold.

buyingCues: Buy live shellfish from a reputable certified source with required tag or label information.
Shells are closed or close when tapped; discard cracked shells and nonresponsive open shells.
Product is cold, smells fresh and mild, and was not stored in fresh water.
seafoodPreparation.thawing: Not applicable; use live shellfish. Do not freeze or thaw live shellfish for this draft.
seafoodPreparation.cleaningOrShellPreparation: Scrub closed responsive shells under cool running water and remove loose beards immediately before cooking; do not soak in fresh water.
seafoodPreparation.drying: Drain well after scrubbing; do not soak live shellfish in fresh water.
seafoodPreparation.grillSurfacePreparation: Preheat a stable heat-safe grill tray over medium-high heat.
seafoodPreparation.stickingPrevention: Keep shellfish on the tray in their shells so juices remain contained.
seafoodPreparation.approximateTime: 8 to 10 minutes, controlled by shell opening and product-specific guidance.
seafoodPreparation.shellOpeningAndDiscardGuidance: Cook until shells open during cooking and discard every shell that does not open; never pry open a non-opening shell to eat it.
crossContactNotes: Keep live raw shellfish and their liquids away from ready-to-eat foods.
Wash hands and sanitize sink, brush, and utensils after raw-shellfish contact.
Use clean tongs and a clean platter for opened cooked shellfish.
